Topsoil is the dark, nutrient-dense layer where roots flourish; subsoil below is leaner.
Bedrock anchors every layer above it — ancient stone, millions of years old.
Decomposing leaves and twigs are the living foundation of Black Gold.
Wheat carries B-vitamins for brain and energy, iron for blood, magnesium for bones.
Purslane delivers omega-3 fatty acids in wild, hardy, succulent form.
Spekboom's succulent leaves offer vitamins, hydration — and sequester carbon.
Oats bring playful energy, soft fiber, and soothing magic for the nervous system.
The Three-Day Awakening Rule: beyond 72 hours, flour's enzymes fade irreversibly.
Sprouted grains brew super-nutrition for chickens — sunset-orange yolks for humans.
Every element serves the next link: nothing discarded, everything recycled.
Home-milled flour preserves the vital nutrients modern milling strips away.
Wild greens — Spekboom, Purslane, Nettle — are secret treasures disguised as weeds.
